latestVersion.changelog:
This skill connects ChatDev 2.0 with OpenClaw and allows OpenClaw to create, manage, and execute multi-agent workflows through the local API.

With this skill, users can:
- Build custom multi-agent systems (MAS) in ChatDev 2.0  through OpenClaw
- Let OpenClaw call your MAS in ChatDev 2.0 dynamically
